The successful candidate will drive automation initiatives through Network Infrastructure as Code (NetIaC), develop CI/CD pipelines, and integrate AI/ML-driven operations to create self-healing, proactive networks. Relevant certifications in networking (such as Cisco CCNP, CCDP), cloud platforms (Azure, GCP), and automation tools are highly preferred. Mentoring engineers and contributing to best practices in NetDevOps, automation, and reliability engineering will be part of the responsibilities. Supporting global 24x7 operations aligned with SRE principles—such as SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets—and driving incident reduction through AIOps initiatives are key objectives of this role.
